# System Architecture Review and Monitoring Requirements

This document outlines critical tasks for the IT & Digital department concerning system architecture.

## Database Migration

*   Urgent review of database migration is required.
*   Database migration must be updated quarterly.
*   Database migration must be monitored quarterly.

## API Monitoring

*   API latency needs to be monitored based on audit findings.

## Encryption Standards

*   Encryption standards require monitoring for updates.
